claims.claim: Consent-based questioning protects privacy and agency. People may choose not to discuss health, money, relationships or other sensitive topics. A question should have a legitimate purpose, an appropriate context and a genuine opportunity to decline. Power differences can make a nominal choice feel compulsory; clarify whether answering is optional and avoid penalties for refusal. Listening also includes respecting silence.
